name: Forecast counts forecast LINES, not forecast headers
note: First reference here counted m_forecast headers and expected 4 against the cube's 117,347. The CUBE was right: its SQL joins m_forecastline and c_period, so the grain is one row per forecast line per period. My reference was wrong, not the model - worth recording, because a mismatch is not automatically a model defect and treating it as one wastes the signal.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM m_forecast f JOIN m_forecastline fl ON f.m_forecast_id=fl.m_forecast_id JOIN c_period p ON p.c_period_id=fl.c_period_id WHERE f.ad_client_id IN (1000026,0)
